# Figure Out Agency

> Figure Out Agency is a premier digital engineering studio specializing in custom web applications, AI product integration, UI/UX design, and high-conversion digital experiences.

## About the Agency
- **Brand Name**: Figure Out Agency
- **Alternate Names**: Figure Out, Figure Out Studio, Figure Out Digital
- **Founder & Lead Engineer**: Ali Raza Awan
- **Official Website**: https://figureout.surge.sh
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/ALI-RAZA-AWAN/Figure-Out

## Core Expertise & Services
1. **Web & Full-Stack Application Development**: High-speed, responsive, custom web applications built with React 18, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Framer Motion.
2. **AI Integration & Intelligent Automation**: Integration of Large Language Models (LLMs), AI workflows, custom chatbot agents, and predictive data pipelines.
3. **UI/UX Design & Brand Systems**: Design systems, interactive prototypes, component libraries, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
4. **Cloud & Database Architecture**: Scalable backend solutions, API development, and Supabase integration.

## Key Projects & Case Studies
- **Aurora**: Next-generation web application dashboard.
- **Sehat Clinic**: Modern digital healthcare and patient management web application.
- **Zamin**: Real estate platform with interactive property exploration.
- **Markaz Travel**: Travel & booking agency platform.
- **Pulse**: Real-time analytics and monitoring dashboard.
